raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-15 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver mixes the two. v2 evening transactions (18:00-24:00 local) land at 00:00-06:00 UTC on the next day, which explains the off-hours alerts and the 36-row spike on 01-19. Fix: convert v2 timestamps to Chicago local time, a fixed UTC-6 in January, in silver_transactions; the gold tables follow from it.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
